cases.scenario: Screen one explicitly supplied existing small batch without generation, global campaign planning, mandatory method record or unused tiers. Observe zero admitted hits then stop; optionally run a later different declared protocol on a new action/batch.
must_observe: Actual existing plan_screen/submit_screen/screen_status or sweep function calls with exact inputs; synthetic executor clearly marked
Real persisted action/receipt identities, fees and zero-hit count; no fabricated zero-valued successful observations
Only requested batch executed; no hidden generator/planner invocation; prior protocol/output/budget history immutable after later method choice
fail_if: Skipping generator or skill requires unrelated previous stage or global router
Zero hits silently becomes failed or successful numeric zero; incurred fees discarded
Changing later method overwrites old batch/protocol/receipt
Mocked facade returns are sole proof of independent capability

cases.scenario: Call the actual calibrate/separation/enrichment function on a declared synthetic panel alone; a constant, tied, reversed-direction or insufficient-support result must permit rejecting/changing the proposed gate without dispatching a campaign.
must_observe: Exact existing function signature, direction/unit, molecular counting and invalid/unknown semantics
No implicit authorization or scientific dispatch from calibration query
Existing revision-bound authorization checks still reject stale or mismatched gate identity
fail_if: Advice automatically authorizes a gate or starts the full pipeline
Undefined/NaN/insufficient support fabricated as a zero success metric
Removing revision guard or rewriting old measured rows is necessary to skip a stage

cases.scenario: Use actual generation-productivity or campaign-planning calculation alone, then choose an existing supplied molecule route or one generator rather than following all suggested stages.
must_observe: Exact real numerical function inputs and outputs, measured versus estimated yield/cost distinguished
Proposal remains advisory; no generator, screen or paid executor automatically launched by reading proposal
A bounded changed choice or explicit stop follows observed feedback; previous proposal and costs preserved
fail_if: Reading a proposal forces Campaign/Supervisor/propose full loop
Skipping generation requires dummy generation artifacts
Estimated cost/yield or missing outcome represented as actual measured success
Removing legacy optional numerical strategy needed merely to prove openness

cases.scenario: Read real persisted workflow/sweep status, heartbeat and receipts on an engineering fixture containing unresolved execution, without running other skills or scheduling work. Explain unknown and stop.
must_observe: Before/after executions, observations, budget reservations and receipt digests unchanged by read-only diagnosis
Actual status/receipt evidence supports pending/unknown; absence of heartbeat alone is not proof of terminal failure
Recommendation to recover/cancel separated from an authorized mutation; no background research loop
fail_if: Status read silently dispatches/retries/settles
Unknown reservation refunded or scalar zero substituted
Claiming cancellation from PID absence without original identity/receipt semantics
Claiming full monitoring migration solely from previous execution recovery tests

cases.scenario: Select one already implemented research numerical or diagnostic function, give its exact callable signature and a small synthetic input, and invoke it without controller.schedule, training a new full policy, or reopening R4b.
must_observe: One named concrete existing function and source path; actual algorithm invocation/result, not just a new method metadata record
Skill states when useful, required input role/units, returned value and uncertainty, and explicit stopping/failure conditions
Nontrivial counterexample e.g. insufficient support/invalid role/constant panel matches existing scientific semantics
All old research sources and historical ledgers unchanged except explicitly owned justified edits
fail_if: A new wrapper merely repeats documentation without proving real callable method
Forced MethodVersion/approval gate before numerical call
Old released labels reused as unseen evaluation or synthetic result claimed independent gain
Algorithm semantics weakened to make advice look usable

cases.scenario: In a fresh isolated native-host data copy, retain an existing complete parent snapshot/version, revise local method content, append a new MethodVersion whose structured parents contains the exact existing parent record ID, then append an observed partial trial/use.
must_observe: Official native CLI actual tool request includes nonempty parents with exact existing parent MethodVersion ID; persisted journal record resolves it
Old and new byte-complete snapshots independently verify and have distinct content hashes
All prior method records, observations, budgets and initial event prefix are byte/semantic unchanged; only intended new records appended
Old parentless record stays parentless; unrelated new root version with parents=[] still accepted
Partial use declaration remains host_reported unless direct tool evidence proves more
fail_if: Parent ID appears only in prose change_summary or requested but rejected write
Old parentless version rewritten to manufacture lineage
Mutable content path replaces frozen parent or stale snapshot hash accepted
New record exists only in hand-authored summary instead of real native response and SQLite
Implementing universal nonempty-parent requirement

cases.scenario: Native host goals constrain task, data and resource scope, not the complete tool sequence. Skill use may be omitted, partial, composed or changed; feedback can trigger stop.
must_observe: Per-run isolated input/config/workspace, official CLI identity, actual prompt and tool request/response JSONL, source/module/import identity
At least one substantive selected capability and visible feedback-dependent changed step or stop; failures retained
Fixture SDK runs, real native host calls, real CPU algorithms and independent scientific improvement distinctly labeled
Updated skill exports/packages bind exact current bytes; no forced full reference injection
fail_if: Prompt supplies mandatory complete ordered calls or demands all pipeline stages
Configuration, exit0, self-report or Python MCP client substitutes for native behavior
Docs/tool descriptions command global first-tool router or mandatory skill
Claude existing401 silently promoted to pass or retried without usable new auth evidence

cases.scenario: Report scoped engineering capability and preserve failures, provenance and resource distinctions.
must_observe: Baseline1157 source files and protected scientific/local fixes preserved, no staging or shared environment changes
Inherited failure costs and unknown outcomes unchanged; native tokens, fixture estimates, measured time and unknown monetary totals separated
Scientific improvement remains not_run absent authorized unseen tasks and equal-budget independent controls
fail_if: Sum overlapping pytest groups as independent coverage
Declare M/S/phi/G benefit from saved methods, documentation reduction or familiar replay
Restart paused R4b or new PRISM/CRO tasks to produce acceptance evidence

verifier_constraints: V only changes owned independent tests/evidence/DELIVERY_V
No changing production or owner tests to fit outcomes
Refinements identify a genuinely ambiguous callable but do not weaken frozen failure criteria
No requirement to rewrite already composable algorithms; prove existing behavior when sufficient
